questions.q: Why isn't combined_df used directly as the model's only table?
options: It's a flat table with descriptive attributes repeated on every row, the wrong shape for slicing two different pages two different ways
Power BI cannot load a DataFrame with more than two columns
combined_df is missing the LineTotal column
Power BI requires at least three fact tables
questions.explain: A star schema separating facts from dimensions is what makes both stakeholder pages possible from one model.

questions.q: What grain does the Fact table hold its rows at?
options: One row per order line, matching the original extract grain
One row per customer
One row per territory
One row per month
questions.explain: Fact keeps LineTotal at the line-level grain the extract was originally built at.

questions.q: Where does CustomerSegment belong in the star schema, and why?
options: On DimCustomer, since it's a descriptive attribute the Marketing Manager's page filters and groups by
On Fact, repeated on every order line
It doesn't belong in the model at all
On DimTerritory, since segments relate to geography
questions.explain: Descriptive attributes belong on dimension tables, not flattened onto the fact table.

questions.q: What direction should the Fact-to-dimension relationships filter?
options: One-to-many, filtering from the dimension side down to Fact
Many-to-one, filtering from Fact up to the dimension
No relationship is needed between Fact and the dimensions
Many-to-many in both directions
questions.explain: One customer or territory relates to many fact rows -- the standard star-schema direction.

questions.q: Why does keeping CustomerSegment and TerritoryGroup on separate dimension tables matter for the upcoming DAX work?
options: A CALCULATE + ALL style measure removes filters from a specific table, which only makes clean sense once that attribute lives on its own dimension
DAX cannot reference columns that live on a fact table
It has no effect on any DAX measure
ALL only works on fact tables, never on dimensions
questions.explain: Lesson 9's ALL(DimTerritory)-style benchmark measure depends on TerritoryGroup/TerritoryName living on their own dimension table.
